furys-cage.name: Fury's Cage
furys-cage.description: The Bloodthirster bound within this weapon offers the wielder immense power but seeks every way to turn its towering wrath upon its jailer. Legiones Daemonica Khorne Monster model only. Each time the bearer is selected to fight, it can use this Enhancement. If it does, the bearer suffers D3+1 mortal wounds, and until the end of the phase, each time it makes an attack, you can re-roll the Hit roll and you can re-roll the Wound roll.
furys-cage.restriction: Legiones Daemonica Khorne Monster model only

gateway-unto-damnation.name: Gateway Unto Damnation
gateway-unto-damnation.description: Concealed within this daemon's form is a portal into the depths of Khorne's realm. Anointed with gore and thrown wide by the daemon's corporeal demise, it expands like a bloody singularity to drag everything in reach into the screaming maelstrom of the Warp. Legiones Daemonica Khorne Monster model only. The bearer's Deadly Demise ability inflicts mortal wounds on a D6 roll of 2+ instead of on a 6. In addition, if the bearer has destroyed one or more enemy units this battle, the bearer has the Deadly Demise D3+3 ability, instead of any other Deadly Demise ability on its datasheet
gateway-unto-damnation.restriction: Legiones Daemonica Khorne Monster model only

Legiones Daemonica Khorne model only.
